steps.name: Retain source and formatting diagnostics
steps.run:
mkdir -p target/cross-origin-native
git rev-parse HEAD > target/cross-origin-native/source-commit.txt
git archive --format=tar.gz HEAD apps crates tools schemas adr .github Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml .cargo sdk examples docs CONTRIBUTING.md > target/cross-origin-native/source.tar.gz
cargo fmt --all -- --check > target/cross-origin-native/format.log 2>&1 || true
cargo fmt --all
git diff --binary > target/cross-origin-native/format.patch
git diff --name-only -z | tar --null -T - -czf target/cross-origin-native/formatted-files.tar.gz
git restore --worktree .
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"

steps.name: Validate native configuration schema
steps.run:
python -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python -m unittest tools.tests.test_cross_origin_native_schema tools.tests.test_cross_origin_native_workflow -v
node --check tools/cross-origin/native-fixture.mjs
node --check tools/cross-origin/native-browser.mjs
node --test tools/cross-origin/contract.test.mjs tools/cross-origin/native-network.test.mjs

steps.name: Execute native policy and ownership controls
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p latentd --lib --locked cross_origin -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee target/cross-origin-native/native-tests.log

steps.name: Build actual node and package CLI
Retain exact native qualification products
steps.run:
mkdir -p target/cross-origin-bin
objcopy --strip-debug target/debug/latent target/cross-origin-bin/latent
objcopy --strip-debug target/debug/latentd target/cross-origin-bin/latentd
tar -C target/cross-origin-bin -czf target/cross-origin-native/native-products.tar.gz latent latentd
sha256sum target/cross-origin-bin/latent target/cross-origin-bin/latentd > target/cross-origin-native/native-products.sha256

steps.name: Qualify signed native TLS publications with real Chromium
steps.run:
npm ci --prefix examples/renderer-profile --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
python3 tools/cross-origin/native_qualify.py --cli target/cross-origin-bin/latent --node target/cross-origin-bin/latentd --toolchain examples/renderer-profile --chrome "$(command -v google-chrome)" --font examples/renderer-profile/node_modules/primeicons/fonts/primeicons.woff2 --output target/cross-origin-native

steps.name: Check maintained formatting and strict native lint
steps.run:
python3 tools/ci_cargo.py run format
cargo clippy --locked -p latentd --lib -- -D warnings

reviewReason: Add six bounded network-recorder controls for raw Chromium header/status evidence, failed requests, event ordering, credential redaction and finite storage; retain all native signed-publication and lint gates.
